DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about a bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。似た自転車がありましたが、鍵が合いません。私の物とは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵不一致と本人所有不確かを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I found a similar bicycle, but my key does not fit. I cannot say for sure that it is mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the key does not fit and that you are unsure you own the bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その自転車を動かしましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 動かしていません。色は同じですが、私のかごには傷があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動と自車の傷を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not moved it. The color is the same, but my bicycle has a scratch on its basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not moved it and that your own bicycle has a scratch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録番号など、ご自分の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any records of your own, such as the registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真があります。番号を今の自転車と照合する方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号資料による照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photo. I would like to ask how to compare the number with the bicycle here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the numbers using your records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。鍵が合わないから盗まれた、とも決めつけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 盗難断定を避けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will also avoid assuming that it was stolen just because the key does not fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will avoid concluding it was stolen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: いつ止めたかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell me when you parked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方です。ただ、列の端だったか中央だったかは曖昧です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐輪日時と位置記憶の曖昧さを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yesterday evening. However, I am not sure whether it was at the end or in the middle of the row.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report when you parked the bicycle and your uncertainty about its position. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自分の資料と駐輪時の状況を確認します。似た自転車には触れずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check your records and the circumstances when you parked it. Please wait without touching the similar bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類は一か所へ送るご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send the documents to one destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ建物ですが、部署が二つあります。一つの封筒にまとめてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一建物別部署への一括発送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are going to the same building, but to two different departments. May I put them together in one envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending documents together to different departments in the same building. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の指示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the receiving office's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それぞれ別の宛名が書いてあります。料金を減らすためだけにまとめるのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別宛名と節約だけで統合しない判断を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have different addressees written on them. I will avoid combining them just to reduce the postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the addressees differ and that you will not combine them solely to save money. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別々に送る場合は、封筒も分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you send them separately, use separate envelopes as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。書類を二組に分けて、対応する宛名を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類組と宛名を対応させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will divide the documents into two sets and put the corresponding addressee on each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match each document set with its addressee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封をする前に中身を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you check the contents before sealing the envelopes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: できます。申請書Aはこちら、Bはもう一方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封入前にAとBの組を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Application form A goes here, and B goes in the other one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the sets for A and B before putting them in and sealing the envelopes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人も両方に記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also fill in the sender's details on both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。片方だけに書かず、二つとも自分の住所を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両封筒に差出人を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will write my address on both, rather than on just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in the sender's details on both envelopes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二通として受付の準備をします。中身と宛名を確認してから封をし、その状態で計量しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will prepare to accept these as two letters. Check the contents and addressees before sealing them, and then we will weigh them sealed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about opening an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社の案内があれば、必ず開設できるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社指定での開設保証を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I have the information from my company, am I guaranteed to be able to open one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the company's designation guarantees that an account can be opened. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込みの条件や必要書類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the application conditions and required documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、会社から指定されたことと、銀行の確認が済んだことは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社案内と銀行確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So being instructed by my company and having completed the bank's checks are separate matters, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the company's guidance from the bank's verification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのとおりです。必要書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is correct. Do you have the necessary documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認書類はあります。会社の案内だけでは足りない物があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人書類と不足資料案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have identification documents. Please tell me if anything else is needed in addition to the company's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention your identification documents and ask what additional documents are needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を見て担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will look over the details and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。会社には、まだ口座番号が発行されたとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号未発行を会社へ正しく伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will not tell my company that an account number has already been issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your company accurately that the account number has not been issued. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: いつまでに会社へ提出する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When are you planning to submit it to your company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今週ですが、未完了なら締切を会社へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未完了時の会社期限相談を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: This week, but if the process is not complete, I will discuss the deadline with my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will discuss the company's deadline if the process is unfinished. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件と書類を確認しましょう。開設の結果が出るまで、申込中として会社へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check the conditions and documents. Until the outcome of opening the account is known, please tell your company that your application is in progress.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは展示用の見本です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そうでしたか。軽いとは思いましたが、そのまま買う物だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 軽い見本を購入品と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oh, I see. I thought it felt light, but I assumed it was the item I would buy as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the light sample for an item for sale. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品は奥の棚にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The products are on the shelves at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見本の蓋を開けずに、店員さんへ返してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封見本を店員へ返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. May I return the sample to a staff member without opening its lid?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Return the unopened sample to a staff member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。こちらでお戻しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We will put it back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中身入りの方も、この容器と同じ大きさですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実商品の容器サイズを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Is the filled product's container the same size as this one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the container size of the actual product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量によって大きさが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The size varies depending on the capacity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、容器の見た目だけで選ばず、内容量を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見た目でなく内容量で比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I would like to check the net contents, rather than choose based only on how the container looks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the amount of contents rather than the appearance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに表示があります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。まず小さい容量の商品を確認してから、購入を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小容量商品の確認後に購入判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check the product with the smaller quantity first, then decide whether to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to buy after checking the smaller-quantity product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見本をお預かりします。奥の商品の内容量をご確認の上、お選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take the sample. Please check the quantities of the products at the back before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲み水です。この水場は飲めますか。表示が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示不明水場の飲用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Drinking water. Is the water at this water point safe to drink? I cannot find a sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether water can be drunk at a water point whose signage is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示を確認できない所では、飲用だと判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where you cannot verify the signage, please do not assume the water is drinking water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。水が透明だから大丈夫、とは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水の見た目で判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will avoid thinking it is fine just because the water is clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you will not judge the water by its appearance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲用の案内がある場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will direct you to a place marked as drinking water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。手を洗う場所と飲む場所を分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲用と手洗いの場所案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I would like separate directions to where I can wash my hands and where I can drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for directions to the drinking-water and handwashing locations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図では、こちらに記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is marked here on the information map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この印ですね。手元の地図にも写しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内印を地図へ記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This symbol, right? I will copy it onto the map I have with me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the information symbol on your map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ただ、場所に着いて飲用表示を確認してから使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器使用前に現地表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. However, I will only use it after arriving and checking the drinking-water sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the sign at the location before using your container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内図の方向へお進みください。現地の表示を確かめてご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go in the direction shown on the information map. Check the sign at the location before using the water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の確認はどなたがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who will be checking the route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今までは兄でしたが、ここからは私が家族を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の経路案内役の交代を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My older brother has been doing it until now, but from here I will guide my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the change in who guides the family along the route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お兄様の調べた経路は見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you see the route your older brother looked up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面はあります。列車名はありますが、乗換駅の名前が途中で切れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面で欠けた乗換駅情報を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the screen. The train name is there, but the transfer station's name is cut off halfway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the missing transfer-station information on the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その部分を確認しましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族を連れて歩き出す前に、欠けた情報を補いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動前の情報補完を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I would like to fill in the missing information before setting off with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to complete the information before moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた情報を共有しておくと安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sharing the information once it is confirmed will give you peace of mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族にも乗換駅を伝えます。私だけが画面を持たないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族全員との経路情報共有を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will tell my family the transfer station too. I will make sure I am not the only one with the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest sharing route information with the whole family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別々になった時の待合せは決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you decided where to meet if you get separated?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。各駅で勝手に移動せず、係員に相談すると決めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 離散時の無断移動を避け相談方針を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. We will agree not to move around stations on our own and to consult a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to avoid moving independently if separated and to consult staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗換駅はこちらです。ご家族と経路を共有し、不明な時は駅係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is the transfer station. Share the route with your family, and ask station staff if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明の対象はご本人だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the certificate to cover only you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出案内には私の名前があります。世帯全員の情報も入れるべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人提出で世帯情報も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is on the submission instructions. Should I include information on everyone in my household too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether household information is needed when submitting a certificate for yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先が求める範囲を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the scope required by the receiving organization.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「本人のみ」とあります。念のため全員分を付ける必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人のみ指定を読み取り確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 'the applicant only.' So I do not need to attach information on everyone just in case, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read and confirm the instruction specifying only the applicant. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な範囲でご申請ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please apply for the scope you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、本人分を希望します。同居人の情報は追加しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な同居人情報を追加しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like it for myself only. I will not add information on the people I live with.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not add unnecessary information on people living with you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載項目の指定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there also specified items to include?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この欄です。読めない項目があるので、意味を聞いてから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な記載項目の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This section here. There are items I cannot read, so I would like to ask what they mean before selecting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of unfamiliar items to be included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 項目の説明をご案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。全項目に丸を付けず、提出案内と合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全項目選択を避け提出条件に合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will match the submission instructions instead of circling every item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid selecting every item and follow the submission requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象はご本人として、指定項目を一緒に確認しましょう。確認後に申請をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check the specified items together, with you as the person covered. Please fill in the application after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の欄が空いていますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前がわかりません。薬は飲んでいますが、飲んでいないとは書きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬名不明でも服用ありと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not know the names. I am taking medicine, so I do not want to write that I am not.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you take medication even though you do not know its name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: わかる情報をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us what you do know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夜に飲みました。袋は家にあり、家族に写真を頼めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終服用時と袋写真の手配を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took it last night. The bags are at home, and I can ask my family for a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the last time you took it and arrange a photo of the medication bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真が届いたら担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the photo to the person in charge when it arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。錠剤の色だけで名前を推測せず、袋を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 錠剤色による薬名推測を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check the bags instead of guessing the medicine's name from the color of the tablets alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid guessing a medicine's name from tablet color. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いくつのお薬かは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you remember how many medications you take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二種類です。ただ、両方を毎回飲むかは袋を見ないと確かではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬種類数と頻度不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two kinds. However, I cannot be sure whether I take both every time until I look at the bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the number of medications from the unknown frequency. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も未確認として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please report that point as unconfirmed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。服用あり、昨夜、二種類、詳細確認中と説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既知の服用情報をまとめて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain that I take medication, took it last night, have two kinds, and am checking the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the known medication information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ今の情報をお伝えください。写真が届きましたら、追加で確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give the person in charge the information you have just shared. When the photo arrives, have them check the additional details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話で何があったのでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母に、私を名乗る電話が来ました。私は母へ電話していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人を名乗る第三者の電話を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother received a call from someone claiming to be me. I have not called her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a third party's call claiming to be you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お母様から何を聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did your mother tell you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事で困り、送金してほしいと言われたそうです。私はその通話を聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母から聞いた要求と直接未聴を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Apparently the caller said they were in trouble at work and wanted her to send money. I did not hear that call myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the request reported by your mother from what you did not hear directly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お母様は送金されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Has your mother sent any money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ確認できていません。母の話と、私が知っていることを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送金有無不明と情報出所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not been able to confirm that yet. I will distinguish what my mother said from what I know myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know whether money was sent and identify your information sources. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、お母様と連絡が取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you contact your mother now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。いつもの番号で連絡します。相手が教えた番号にはかけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通常連絡先で母へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will use her usual number. I will not call the number the caller gave her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm with your mother using her usual contact number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 着信の時刻や内容も聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also ask about the time and contents of the call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。母の記録を残し、私からの電話ではなかったと先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録保全と本人未発信を家族へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will preserve my mother's records and first tell her that the call was not from me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Preserve the records and tell your family that you did not make the call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人へのなりすましが疑われる相談としてお伺いします。確認できた経緯と、ご家族の対応をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your report as a suspected case of impersonation. Please tell us the sequence of events you have confirmed and how your family has responded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの二箱を発送しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending these two boxes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一箱だけです。もう一つは、買った物を家へ持ち帰る箱です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参二箱のうち発送一箱を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only one. The other box is for taking my purchases home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Specify that only one of the two boxes you brought is to be sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送するのはどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名を付けた方です。似た箱なので、持帰り分は自分の足元へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名付き箱と持帰り箱を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one with the address label. The boxes look similar, so I will put the one I am taking home by my feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the addressed box from the box you are taking home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口の通路をふさがないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not block the passage by the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、足元でなく鞄の中へ入れます。発送分だけこちらに渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路を避け持帰り箱を鞄へしまう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will put it in my bag instead of by my feet. I will hand you only the box to be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the box you are taking home in your bag to keep the passage clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送分の中身を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me what is in the box you are sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 衣類です。持帰りの箱の食品とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送衣類と持帰り食品を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Clothing. It is separate from the food in the box I am taking home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the clothing being sent from the food being taken home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛名はこちらでよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the correct address, isn't it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この宛名です。計量も衣類の一箱だけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名照合と一箱だけの計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, this address. Please weigh only the one box of clothing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the address and request that only one box be weighed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 衣類の一箱として受付します。持帰りのお荷物も忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept one box of clothing for shipment. Please remember to take the belongings you are taking home with you too.
